item.title: Second degree murder charge for Norfolk teen after infant's death in Port Rowan
item.description: A 16-year-old Norfolk County resident has been charged with second degree murder in connection to the death of a baby last year. Norfolk County OPP made the arrest on Wednesday, January 28 following an investigation into the sudden death of an infant at a Front Road residence in Port Rowan on Tuesday, November 4, 2025. […]
